# Ciphertext as transcribed by dbourdeau/cyphersolver (castelcicala1816/transcripts/, commit fc0c9e8, 25 Sept 2026;
# MIT code / CC BY 4.0 text, credited per CLAUDE.md item 8) -- copied here as-is, not re-transcribed or repaired.
# One row per record (all cipher lines of that record concatenated in image order); groups space-separated.
# A group of 5+ digits is a null (kept as written, decoded as NULL). R9586 and R9588 use a different code
# (values ~100-1100) and are excluded from this file; see NOTES.md.
